title: Global convergence of an efficient splitting method for the defocusing Gross--Pitaevskii ground state problem
summary: For computing the ground state of the defocusing Gross--Pitaevskii energy, we propose and analyze two efficient schemes based on the Davis--Yin three-operator splitting, which treats the potential and interaction terms explicitly, and the kinetic energy by a resolvent. One iteration costs one inversion of $I-γΔ$ for the first scheme, and of $I-γΔ+γV_1$ for the second, with $V_1$ denoting the separable part of the potential, and on structured meshes both operators can be inverted by simple fast GPU solvers.
